To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) after outdoor storage the cryodipoes show no signs of degradation in terms of electrical and vacuum integrity and quench training behavior; 2) the magnetic field quality and the thermal insulation performance are not affected by outdoor storage; 3) the mechanical stability of the cryodipoes, including the interface between the cryodipoe and the cryostat, is preserved after outdoor storage.
